name: Pangaia Hinxworth
source:
Kaine, an airdtrìath or immortal, the dorcharigh (dark king) from Dubh Faiche kingdom, has tried to pierce the arcane sphere that contains his land for several millennia, placed there by the Airdrìgh Rycharde, also an airdtrìath, with the aid of powerful mages of his kingdom of Afallon. A few times Kaine has successfully pierced it, usually with small projectiles the size of small rocks.
Several centuries ago, a chunk of magikally infused stone hurtled into space. It has returned to Pangaia with a firey tail crashing on a small mountain within the borders of northern Afallon, on the 4th of Mae[2] 4699Æ.

Keket, Iona, and Boadicea (the three protagonists) find a remnant of a meteorite; filled with cthunhonimic magik that they mistakenly released. Now they must find a way to exorcise the town and surrounding land of the cthunhonimic creatures and their mana.
